extension.description: A dark, cinematic Kodi skin with glass panels, large backdrops and rows for Trakt continue watching, trending titles, your library and your liked Trakt lists (via Seren).
Een donkere, cinematische Kodi-skin met glazen panelen, grote achtergronden en rijen voor Trakt verder kijken, trending titels, je bibliotheek en je Trakt-lijsten (via Seren).
extension.news: 1.21.1: Sport: tidier loading (one calm panel with a progress bar the first time, a small bar while updating or reading the guide), and the big card on My sport only shows games of teams you follow. 1.21.0: new TV tab: your IPTV channels with groups, what is on now (with progress) and next, search, OK to watch. Sport finds the TV guide better: checks again, retries an empty guide after 5 minutes and shows the reason when no guide is found. 1.20.0: Sport: OK on a game opens a full game page. Team games show both teams with record, place and form, the start time with a countdown, your channels, Remind / Record / Follow / Fix channel, match info and the league table with both teams highlighted. Races and events get their own layout with the schedule of the weekend. 1.19.0: Sport > Follow is now a page: sports on the left (with the number you follow), competitions on top, and the teams as colour cards; OK follows or stops following. The strip on top shows everything you follow; Search, Order and More open the old tools. 1.18.0: Sport > All games looks like the reference: rows with league, team logos, names and records, channel and arrow, a heading with the number of games, red outline on the selected game. 1.17.5: Sport > My sport: the big card only shows games of the teams you follow. 1.17.4: Sport: fixes HTTP 400 from ESPN (it no longer accepts a date range, so games are fetched day by day). 1.17.3: Sport: asks ESPN like a normal browser and retries when busy; the error message shows the HTTP code. 1.17.2: Sport: shows Loading while games are fetched and a message when ESPN cannot be reached. 1.17.1: Sport > My sport: every team, competition or name you follow now has its own row, also without games or without IPTV. 1.17.0: Sport > My sport has a new start screen: a big card of your next game in both team colours (Left/Right flips), your channels next to it, and a row of game cards per team or competition with scores, times and channel. The background takes the colours of the game you select. OK on a game opens a menu (watch, remind, record, fix channel, follow, table). 1.16.1: Sport: tables that were saved by an older version showed empty (Eredivisie, Eerste Divisie, Belgium); fixed, and the list of tables opens faster. 1.16.0: Sport: almost 200 competitions from ESPN (football worldwide, NBA, NFL, NHL, MLB, rugby, F1, IndyCar, NASCAR, golf, tennis, UFC and more); Follow > Choose competitions picks the sport first. 1.15.0: Sport tables: last five results as coloured squares, place changes (up/down arrows), coloured edges for Champions League, Europa League and relegation, team colours, your teams outlined in gold, and a team card (OK on a team) with record, home and away form, last three results, next game, Watch now, Remind me, Follow and all games. 1.14.0: Sport: Fix channel (remembered per game, competition or team), reminders (5 minutes before), automatic switching (1 minute before, 10 seconds to cancel), recording for 1 to 6 hours, optional automatic reminders for your teams. 1.13.1: Sport: follow countries (Follow > Choose countries, or search), with friendlies, Nations League, European Championship and World Cup, shown with Dutch country names. 1.13.0: Sport > My sport: big card with your next games in the team colours (Left/Right flip), Live & upcoming, then a block per team, competition or name in your own order with your place in the league. Search to follow a team, country or competition; following a club includes its cups and European games. 1.12.1: in choice lists with check marks (like Follow teams) the check is visible on the highlighted row, and Right jumps straight to OK. 1.12.0: new Sport tab: all games of your competitions with times, scores and tables, and the IPTV channels (from your IPTV Simple Client guide) that show each game. Follow competitions, teams or a name. 1.11.4: the update pop-up now really installs the new version (downloads it itself and reloads the skin). 1.11.3: Profiles screen: the two top rows now have their text, profiles get a person icon. 1.11.2: Skin settings buttons open the right category (Seren > Accounts for Trakt, Seren > Playback, Kodi language settings) instead of the first one. 1.11.1: optional automatic subtitle search (A4KSubtitles) when a film or episode starts without subtitles in your language. 1.11.0: A4KSubtitles support: Search subtitles button in the player menu, settings and a Use as default button in Skin settings > Integrations. 1.10.0: pop-up when a new version of Lucent is available (Update now / Later / Skip this version), switch and Check now in Skin settings > Integrations. 1.9.10: add-on info page uses the full width in a glass panel, Automatic update switch no longer cut off. 1.9.9: colour swatch in subtitle settings (Colour, Border colour) sits on the right of the row. 1.9.8: System info screen tidier (each line in its own row, CPU/RAM/temperature as pills). 1.9.7: Calendar info text scrolls by itself when long, watched check stays red on the focused row, System info first tab says Summary. 1.9.6: wider Calendar, week cards no longer clipped, series logos in the week view, Up wraps around in Add-ons and library lists. 1.9.5: watched check marks are red, calendar buttons and week view tidied. 1.9.4: Calendar opens a series straight on its seasons in Seren (no search), week view spacing. 1.9.3: list view: the duration no longer disappears behind the watched check mark. 1.9.2: the Calendar now shows the series and films of your Trakt collection; the bell (off by default) gives a pop-up for a new episode or a digital film release. 1.9.1: nicer on-screen keyboard, Enter on a real keyboard now finishes typing, the Settings home screen wraps around. 1.9.0: new Calendar tab (Week, List, Month) for the series and films you follow with the bell on the info page, with a pop-up when a new episode is out (Watch now / Later; switch in Skin settings > Tracking). 1.8.5: Home rows and skin settings wrap around too. 1.8.4: Back stops the video, lists wrap around, Right goes to OK in add-on settings, trailers stop when you move on. 1.8.3: trailer video no longer hidden behind the Home background on CoreELEC. 1.8.2: trailers close the YouTube error pop-up and pause after repeated failures. 1.8.1: sidebar now says Lucent. 1.8.0: Lucent is now its own add-on (skin.lucent). On first start it takes over all settings, menu and widgets of Nuvio Arc.

extension.summary: Pop-up bij een nieuwe versie van het Seren-thema Lucent
Pop-up when a new version of the Lucent Seren theme is released
extension.description: Kijkt op GitHub of er een nieuwe versie van het Seren-thema Lucent is. Is dat zo, dan krijg je een pop-up met wat er nieuw of veranderd is, en kun je meteen bijwerken. Na een update zie je één keer wat er nieuw is.
Checks GitHub for a new version of the Lucent Seren theme and shows a pop-up with the release notes, with the option to update right away.
extension.news: 1.1.0: nieuwe naam Lucent; herkent het thema onder de naam Lucent en de oude naam; testknop in de instellingen.
